description:
[Trading Data API] Latest crypto headlines aggregated from Cointelegraph, Decrypt and Bitcoin Magazine, newest first: title, source, URL, published time and a short summary — Latest crypto headlines aggregated from Cointelegraph, Decrypt and Bitcoin Magazine, newest first: title, source, URL, published time and a short summary. Filter by keyword or source.

**Example:** `/v1/crypto-news?q=etf&limit=10`

q.description: Optional. Keyword filter on title and summary.

source.description: Optional. cointelegraph, decrypt or bitcoinmagazine (default all).

name: crypto_news
